name: ProWritingAid
tagline: Style and grammar editor with manuscript-level feedback for authors.
description: ProWritingAid goes beyond grammar to analyze pacing, sentence variety, dialogue tags, and readability, plus AI-driven manuscript critique, beta-reader simulation, and story analysis. It integrates into Word, Google Docs, Scrivener, and browsers, aimed at long-form and fiction writers.
insight: Its reports target craft signals fiction writers care about — pacing, sensory detail, dialogue tags — not rivals' business-copy framing.

modelSupport.notes: Combines its own writing-analysis engine with AI critique features; states it does not train on user text.
